Steer your boat along the arrow to
get the most speed out of the wind.

With Engineer's Goggles, shows the
wind alignment as a percentage.
item.create_high_seas.rudder.tooltip.beh:
Sails read it to find the boat's forward
direction. Place it at the stern.

Mount it on a Swivel Bearing to rotate it
and steer the boat.
item.create_high_seas.anchor.tooltip.sum: A heavy weight to stop your boat.
item.create_high_seas.anchor.tooltip.beh:
The anchor normally weighs 20 kilos.
As soon as it touches the bottom, it weighs 1 ton.
item.create_high_seas.anchor.tooltip.con: When Right-Clicked with a Steel Cable:
item.create_high_seas.anchor.tooltip.beh:
Turns the anchor into a sublevel and
connects it to the rope winch.
item.create_high_seas.oar_of_boat.toolti: Gives your boat a stroke forward.
Keeps rowing to move forward steadily.
message.create_high_seas.helm.engaged: Sneak to let go of the tiller
message.create_high_seas.helm.occupied: Someone is already at the helm
message.create_high_seas.helm.not_a_ship: This engine is not mounted on a ship
message.create_high_seas.helm.blocked: There is no room to sit at the tiller
item.create_high_seas.boat_engine.toolti: A compact propulsion unit, powered by fuel.

Burns fuel to spin a propeller.
Mount it at the stern, with the propeller in the water.

Takes control of the engine.
Sneak to let go of the tiller.
When Right-Click is Held at the Helm:

Move the mouse to set the speed limit,
from 0 to 15.
item.create_high_seas.seaglide.tooltip.s: A handheld thruster for underwater travel.
item.create_high_seas.seaglide.tooltip.b:
Twin counter-rotating fans pull you
through the water. It runs on your own stamina,
not on fuel.

Spins up the fans and drives you forward.
Slowly drains your hunger, and cuts out
once it is empty. Attacks are disabled while it runs.

Throws you into a leap.
Aim upwards before surfacing to fly higher.

Vaults you forward from dry land.
Holding it is enough, it need not be running.
block.create_high_seas.buoy.tooltip.summ: A towable float that rides the surface.
block.create_high_seas.buoy.tooltip.beha:
Drops into the water and stays there,
whatever the rope does to it.

Climb into the ring.
Sneak to get back out.

Hitches the line to the handle
instead of seating you.

Skips off the surface in bursts of up to
three bounces, as high as three blocks.
create_high_seas.configuration.anchorHol:
Mass a dropped anchor pins the ship with once it bites the sea floor.
Raise it if big ships still drift at anchor.
Wind strength with no weather and no gust, before terrain and altitude.
This is the baseline every other wind figure is measured against.
create_high_seas.configuration.buoyMaxRi: Fastest a buoy climbs back to the surface, in blocks per second.
create_high_seas.configuration.buoyMaxSi: Fastest a buoy is allowed to be dragged under, in blocks per second.
create_high_seas.configuration.enginePow: Boat engine thrust at full throttle.
create_high_seas.configuration.engineRev: Share of that power available in reverse.
create_high_seas.configuration.gustAmpli:
How far gusts swing above and below the baseline, as a fraction of it.
0 = perfectly steady wind, 1 = gusts from nothing to double strength.
create_high_seas.configuration.oarMaxSpe: Speed past which rowing stops helping, in blocks per tick.
create_high_seas.configuration.oarStroke: Push delivered by one oar stroke.
create_high_seas.configuration.rainBoost: Extra wind while it rains, as a fraction of the baseline.
create_high_seas.configuration.sailPower:
Overall sail power. The single knob for how fast sailing ships go.
Drag is quadratic, so doubling this does NOT double top speed: roughly four times the power is needed to go twice as fast.
create_high_seas.configuration.sailResca:
Ticks between two sweeps looking for sails on a ship.
Higher is cheaper but slower to notice a sail being added or removed.
create_high_seas.configuration.sailSubdi: Sail mesh subdivision level (GPU tessellation). Lower = blockier, vanilla-Minecraft look. Higher = smoother, cloth-like billowing. Purely aesthetic, negligible performance cost. Applies when you close the config.
create_high_seas.configuration.sailUpwin:
Worst-case efficiency when sailing straight into the wind.
0 = dead in the water against the wind, 1 = heading no longer matters.
create_high_seas.configuration.sailWindB:
How much the wind adds on top of the windless thrust, per block of canvas.
Raise it to make wind matter more, lower it to make sailing predictable.
create_high_seas.configuration.sailWindl:
Thrust a sail still gives with no wind at all, per block of canvas.
This is what stops a becalmed ship from being stranded.
create_high_seas.configuration.seaglideM: Top speed under the seaglide, in blocks per tick. 0.45 is about 9 blocks per second.
create_high_seas.configuration.seaglideP: Push the seaglide adds each tick while running.
create_high_seas.configuration.seaglideS:
Camera shake and wind speed-lines at full seaglide speed.
Turn it off if the motion bothers you; speed itself is unchanged.
create_high_seas.configuration.terrainSh:
How much terrain upwind can steal from the wind.
0 = terrain never blocks wind, 1 = a cliff can cut it entirely.
create_high_seas.configuration.thunderBo: Extra wind during a thunderstorm, as a fraction of the baseline.
create_high_seas.configuration.title: Create High Seas
